description:
foobar2000 is an advanced freeware audio player for the Windows platform.


- Fixed bitcompare crash on specific input.
- Improved Matroska seeking performance, made trust timestamps written by latest mkvtoolnix.
- New UPnP streaming options: icy-meta-format (title formatting pattern), icy-meta-encoding ("ANSI", "UTF-8" or a codepage number).
- Fixed non gapless playback of specific HE-AAC tracks.
- SMB network share support fixes, improved interaction with macOS File Sharing.
- Components auto update UI refresh.
- Fixed wrong alignment of controls in ReplayGain Scanner Preferences.
- FFmpeg updated to 9.0.2.
- zlib updated to 1.4.
